headline: UnionBank to Absorb Digital Banking and Fintech Subsidiaries
summary: Union Bank of the Philippines is moving to integrate the operations of its digital banking and fintech subsidiaries into its parent entity to streamline services and cut costs.
why: Consolidating digital and traditional banking operations helps institutions optimize regulatory compliance and operational efficiencies.

impacts.name: Union Bank of the Philippines
impacts.why: Absorbing subsidiaries streamlines group operations and centralizes digital banking activities.
